item.title: Personalised GPT News — 16 August 2026
item.description:
Fresh practical developments this week include a new Alzheimer’s imaging approval, major changes to Microsoft Copilot and Windows, new Android sharing and security controls, several new Australia–Asia travel links, and a New Zealand biometric-privacy deadline now fully in force.

  1. FDA approves a new tau-PET imaging agent for Alzheimer’s assessment. On 14 August, the US FDA approved Lantheus’ Tauklarify for PET scans in cognitively impaired adults being assessed for Alzheimer’s disease. The agent makes abnormal tau deposits visible on brain scans; the approval was supported by studies involving scans from more than 500 participants. 14 Aug 2026. Source
  2. Microsoft is merging its personal and work Copilot apps. Microsoft has begun rolling out a unified Microsoft Copilot app on mobile and web, combining the consumer Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences while keeping personal and work data separated. Windows and Mac versions are scheduled to follow in mid-September; Podcasts, Deep Research and Group Chats are among features being phased out after 18 August. 14 Aug 2026. Source
  3. Android adds tap-to-share to Quick Share. Google has started rolling out a proximity sharing mode that lets supported Android phones transfer files and contact information by tapping devices together. It launches first on Pixel 6-series and newer devices, with Samsung support beginning on new Fold and Flip models and broader expansion planned later in 2026. 13 Aug 2026. Source
  4. (Privacy) New Zealand’s biometric-processing transition period has ended. Organisations that were already using facial recognition, voice identification, fingerprint access or similar biometric systems before the Biometric Processing Privacy Code took effect had until 3 August 2026 to bring those systems into compliance. That transition period has now expired, so existing systems are fully subject to the code. 3 Aug 2026. Source
  5. Windows 11’s August update adds more control over AI components and biometric sign-in. Microsoft’s August 2026 Windows 11 update includes support for Windows Hello Enhanced Sign-in Security with external fingerprint sensors and allows Copilot+ PC users to uninstall the local Image Generation AI model. It also includes File Explorer, search, touchpad and accessibility improvements. 11 Aug 2026. Source
  6. (Australia) Western Sydney International gets a new Vietnam connection. Vietjet has announced non-stop Western Sydney–Ho Chi Minh City flights from 10 January 2027, initially twice weekly and increasing to three times weekly in March. Vietjet Thailand is also planning four weekly Western Sydney–Bangkok services from November 2027. 10 Aug 2026. Source
  7. (Australia) Air New Zealand is adding Auckland–Western Sydney flights. Air New Zealand says it will begin non-stop Auckland–Western Sydney International services in November 2026, giving New Zealand travellers a second Sydney airport option. Current 2026 network update. Source
  8. Christchurch gains a new direct Perth service. Air New Zealand’s current network now lists non-stop Christchurch–Perth flights beginning in December 2026, subject to government approvals and seasonal review. This creates a new direct South Island–Western Australia option. 2026 network update. Source
  9. Christchurch gains direct Singapore flights this northern winter. Air New Zealand will operate three weekly Christchurch–Singapore Boeing 787 services during the 2026 northern-winter season. Together with Singapore Airlines, the two carriers will operate up to 15 weekly Christchurch–Singapore services during the peak period from November 2026 to February 2027. Starts Nov 2026. Source
  10. (Travel) Jetstar has suspended Auckland–Sunshine Coast flights. Jetstar has removed its Auckland–Sunshine Coast service after the route underperformed. Air New Zealand continues to operate a seasonal Auckland–Sunshine Coast service, so the direct market remains but with less carrier competition. 5 Aug 2026. Source
  11. Air New Zealand has launched Queenstown–Brisbane seasonal flights. The new service began on 22 June and operates three times a week through 23 October 2026, adding roughly 16,500 seats to the trans-Tasman network. Current through Oct 2026. Source
  12. (Australia) Melbourne gets a new direct Colombo route this month. Jetstar is due to begin Melbourne–Colombo flights on 25 August using retrofitted Boeing 787-8 aircraft with an expanded business-class cabin. Starts 25 Aug 2026. Source
  13. (Australia) Melbourne will gain a one-stop Finnair service to Helsinki. Finnair is scheduled to begin daily Melbourne–Helsinki flights via Bangkok on 26 October 2026 using Airbus A350 aircraft, creating a new through-service option between Melbourne and northern Europe. Starts 26 Oct 2026. Source
  14. Microsoft 365 feature development on Windows 10 is now being phased out. Starting in August 2026, Microsoft is no longer introducing new Microsoft 365 app features to Windows 10 for Personal, Family and Current Channel business users. Security updates continue, but new Office capabilities increasingly require Windows 11. Aug 2026. Source
  15. Android 17 introduces temporary precise-location sharing and stronger anti-theft controls. Google’s Android 17 security changes include a one-use precise-location button for apps, tighter PIN-guess limits, default-on theft protection on new or freshly reset Android 17 devices, scam detection for chat notifications, and new OS/app authenticity verification on Pixel devices. 2026 rollout. Source
  16. (Privacy) New Zealand’s new indirect-data collection rule is now active. Privacy Principle 3A, in force since 1 May 2026, requires agencies collecting personal information indirectly to take reasonable steps to tell the affected person what is being collected and why, subject to statutory exceptions. In force 1 May 2026. Source
  17. New Zealand’s stalking and harassment offence is now in force. Since 26 May 2026, repeated specified conduct such as following, tracking, recording, doxxing or unwanted technology-mediated contact can fall under a dedicated stalking and harassment offence carrying a maximum five-year prison term. Police can also issue a stalking and harassment notice after a single incident. In force 26 May 2026. Source
  18. (Entertainment) The End of Oak Street opened in cinemas. Warner Bros.’ wide-release science-fiction thriller starring Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor opened on 14 August. The film follows a suburban street mysteriously displaced into a prehistoric environment populated by dinosaurs. Released 14 Aug 2026. Source
